name: android_launch_app
description: Launches an application by package name using the default launcher activity. With measure: true, launches with `am start -W` and returns the time to first frame (cold start by default: force-stops the app first).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

coldStart.description: measure: force-stop first to include process start (default true).
